title: Village land forest reserves
rule: A village council may declare an area of village land to be a village land forest reserve, either by declaration alone or by gazetting.
points: Two kinds: a declared village land forest reserve, or a gazetted one (s.32(1)). Reserves already existing at commencement are deemed declared (s.32(2)).
May be owned and managed by one or more villages, across one or more local authorities (s.32(3)).

A village council starts the process by resolution: declaring the area, applying to the Director (through the local authority) to have it gazetted, or negotiating a joint management agreement (s.33(1)).

Villagers' basic rights and duties, unless an agreement says otherwise: the right to exercise existing rights to enter, occupy, use and harvest forest produce jointly with other villagers, sustainably and under any village forest plan, by-laws or customary practice; the duty to comply with licence conditions, help implement the management plan (including communal work), and help enforce the rules (s.40).
